dn<=2||dn===7;});if(needs.length===0)return[{json:{skip:true}}];const fields='campaign_name,spend,video_thruplay_watched_actions_video_view,cost_per_thruplay_video_view,video_p50_watched_actions_video_view,video_p75_watched_actions_video_view,video_p95_watched_actions_video_view,actions_onsite_conversion_post_save,actions_comment,actions_onsite_conversion_messaging_conversation_started_7d,actions_lead,cost_per_action_type_lead';let wd=[];try{const wr=await this.helpers.httpRequest({method:'GET',url:`https://connectors.windsor.ai/facebook?api_key=${WINDSOR_KEY}&date_preset=last_7d&fields=${fields}`,headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}});wd=wr.data||[];}catch(e){return[{json:{skip:true,msg:e.message}}];}if(wd.length===0)return[{json:{skip:true}}];const m={};for(const row of wd){const n=(row.campaign_name||'').trim();if(!n)continue;if(!m[n])m[n]={spend:0,tp:0,v50:0,v75:0,v95:0,saves:0,comments:0,dms:0,leads:0};const x=m[n];x.spend+=Number(row.spend||0);x.tp+=Number(row.video_thruplay_watched_actions_video_view||0);x.v50+=Number(row.video_p50_watched_actions_video_view||0);x.v75+=Number(row.video_p75_watched_actions_video_view||0);x.v95+=Number(row.video_p95_watched_actions_video_view||0);x.saves+=Number(row.actions_onsite_conversion_post_save||0);x.comments+=Number(row.actions_comment||0);x.dms+=Number(row.actions_onsite_conversion_messaging_conversation_started_7d||0);x.leads+=Number(row.actions_lead||0);}for(const n of Object.keys(m)){const x=m[n];x.cpt=x.tp>0?x.spend/x.tp:0;x.cpl=x.leads>0?x.spend/x.leads:0;}const updated=[];for(const camp of needs){const sn=(camp.title||'').trim();let met=m[sn];if(!met){for(const wn of Object.keys(m)){if(wn.toLowerCase().includes(sn.toLowerCase())||sn.toLowerCase().includes(wn.toLowerCase())){met=m[wn];break;}}}if(!met)continue;await this.helpers.httpRequest({method:'PATCH',url:`https://app.smartsuite.com/api/v1/applications/${CAMPAIGNS_APP}/records/${camp.id}/`,headers:{'Authorization':SS_TOKEN,'ACCOUNT-ID':SS_ACCOUNT,'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:{spend:Math.round(met.spend*100)/100,thruplays:met.tp,cost_thruplay:Math.round(met.cpt*1000)/1000,views_50:met.v50,views_75:met.v75,views_95:met.v95,saves:met.saves,comments:met.comments,dms:met.dms,leads:met.leads,cost_lead:Math.round(met.cpl*100)/100,last_pull_date:todayStr}});updated.push(sn);}if(updated.length===0)return[{json:{skip:true}}];return[{json:{skip:false,slackUser:ANDREW_SLACK,count:updated.length,summary:updated.join(', '),date:todayStr}}];
